name: Lyo.Tts.AwsPolly
tagline: Amazon Polly integration: `AwsPollyTtsService` extends `TtsServiceBase<AwsPollyTtsRequest>` with voice selection, output formats, bulk synthesis, metrics, and DI helpers.
description:
[Amazon Polly](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/) integration: `AwsPollyTtsService` extends `TtsServiceBase<AwsPollyTtsRequest>` with voice selection, output formats, bulk
synthesis, metrics, and DI helpers.

**Target frameworks:** `netstandard2.0`, `net10.0`

examples.title: Quick start (code)
Register with DI

sections.title: Quick start (code)
sections.text: Prefer **IAM roles**, environment credentials, or the shared credentials file instead of embedding `AccessKeyId` / `SecretAccessKey`.

sections.title: Dependency injection
items: `AwsPollyTtsAppService` — a thin adapter that converts `TtsResult<AwsPollyTtsRequest>` into `TtsSynthesisResult`.
`ITtsService` (non-generic) backed by `AwsPollyTtsAppService`, so callers that only need the simple contract can resolve it directly without referencing the Polly-specific types.

sections.title: Behaviour notes
rows: `LanguageCode` on `AwsPollyTtsRequest` is primarily for selection; a fixed `VoiceId` determines spoken language
`AwsPollyTtsAppService` adapts `AwsPollyTtsService` to `ITtsService.SynthesizeAsync(text, voiceId)`, surfacing the first error message on failure and audio bytes on success
